scripts.stark:vectors: node tools/stark/gen-vectors.mjs > tools/stark/vectors.jsonl && docker run --rm -i -v nektar-stark-target:/work/target -v ./tools/stark:/work nektar-stark-build sh /work/run-vectors.sh < tools/stark/vectors.jsonl
scripts.stark:datalog-vectors: node tools/stark/gen-vectors-datalog.mjs > tools/stark/vectors-der.jsonl && docker run --rm -i -v nektar-stark-target:/work/target -v ./tools/stark:/work nektar-stark-build sh /work/run-vectors-der.sh < tools/stark/vectors-der.jsonl
scripts.curve:vectors: docker run --rm -v "$PWD/..:/w" -w /w/nektar/tools/curve-vectors -e CARGO_TARGET_DIR=/tmp/t rust:1-slim cargo run -q
scripts.cedar:symcc: docker run --rm -v "$PWD/tools/cedar-symcc:/w" -w /w -e CARGO_TARGET_DIR=/tmp/t rust:1-slim sh run.sh
scripts.smt:vectors: docker run --rm -v "$PWD/..:/w" -w /w/nektar/tools/smt-vectors -e CARGO_TARGET_DIR=/tmp/t rust:1-slim cargo run -q
